exposure: abdominal scars from a caesarean section
outcome: Relative electromyographic activity of the rectus abdominis, transverse abdominis/oblique internus and lumbar multifidus muscles
Ellipse area, amplitude, displacement, velocity, standard deviation, and spectral power of the centre of pressure
cohort: 21 healthy primiparous women who had given birth more than one year prior
finding: Women with c-sections had significantly different CoP medial-lateral velocity and mean velocity compared to women with physiologic deliveries, but no significant differences in muscle activity, antagonist co-activation, or thoracic and lumbar curvatures.
mod_finding: Women with c-section scars exhibited differences in postural control-stability, specifically in center of pressure velocity, compared to those with vaginal deliveries.
